import StacksPart01Lib.FiniteModule

namespace StacksPart01

noncomputable section

variable {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

theorem probe_sup_span_cyclic (N : Submodule R M) (x : M) :
    ∃ I : Ideal R, Nonempty ((R ⧸ I) ≃ₗ[R]
      (↥(N ⊔ R ∙ x) ⧸ Submodule.comap (N ⊔ R ∙ x).subtype N)) := by
  let P : Submodule R M := N ⊔ R ∙ x
  let p : Submodule R M := R ∙ x
  let xp : p := ⟨x, Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span (by simp))⟩
  let f0 : R →ₗ[R] p := LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R p ⟨x, Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨1, by simp⟩⟩
  let D : Submodule R p := Submodule.comap p.subtype p ⊓ Submodule.comap p.subtype N
  let q : p →ₗ[R] p ⧸ D := Submodule.mkQ D
  let f : R →ₗ[R] p ⧸ D := q.comp f0
  have hf0 : Function.Surjective f0 := by
    intro y
    rcases y.property with ⟨a, ha⟩
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa [f0, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply] using ha.symm
  have hq : Function.Surjective q := Submodule.mkQ_surjective D
  have hf : Function.Surjective f := hq.comp hf0
  let e : (p ⧸ D) ≃ₗ[R]
      (↥P ⧸ Submodule.comap P.subtype N) :=
    LinearMap.quotientInfEquivSupQuotient p N
  exact ⟨LinearMap.ker f, ⟨(f.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hf).trans e⟩⟩

end
end StacksPart01
